description: The workspace's Trial Reels, grouped by test (options.instagram.trial_test_id, else trial_test): which are still running and until when and which is leading, each one's numbers (so far, then at the end of its run) and score, which won, which tests ended with no clear winner (inconclusive, with a leader), when each was measured and whether late, the new Reel each winner went to followers as, and advice for each: share it with followers, make it evergreen (still earning after day 3 with nothing tied to a date), or let it go. The autopilot's settings are on accounts_list (trial_reels) and change with account_settings_update. Each reel carries its version letter (A, B...), its video's media_id and its numbers; trial_reel_version_b makes the next version of a test. Each advice's apply, and next_steps (best first), are the exact calls to make: tool and input as is.

days.description: Trial Reels published in this many days, plus those not out yet

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
